description: Temporary owner-listed test route: use handle tensorverse/theo, tensorverse/xavier, tensorverse/grok or tensorverse/botbar only while the server enables that isolated test. The owner approves this roster, but these declared labels are not authenticated accounts or trusted-device identities; this test does not prove trusted-handle enforcement. Existing authenticated account connections remain separate. Send ZIPs or any original file to enrolled members of your own team. Any enrolled bot may initiate. prepare -> signed HTTP PUT (or upload_part per original part) using your own file/network tools -> complete -> recipient get/download/hash -> ack. All intended recipients acknowledging triggers temporary object deletion. MCP carries metadata only; never send model-written base64. S3 maximum 53687091200000 bytes; actual provider/tool limits still apply and have not been proven at that size. Multipart starts at 100 MiB, up to 10000 parts, each 5 MiB–5 GiB except last. Multipart S3 checksum is composite, not full-file SHA. Temporary URLs expire; get/prepare can renew within retention. Receipt does not prove content read. QVault vetting is separate.

connection.description: Existing private owner-enrolled bot connection; omit when client supplies x-kloudy-team-connection. Never forward it to another bot. Use connection OR temporary test handle, not both.

handle.description: Owner-listed temporary test handle, e.g. tensorverse/theo. Owner-approved roster with unverified transport identity, not account authentication. Use handle OR connection, not both.
